My Story

From learning programming fundamentals to building practical projects with data and AI.

I'm Uzaam Shaad K, a Bachelor of Computer Applications graduate with a strong interest in technology and problem-solving. I enjoy understanding how systems work and using software and data to create useful solutions.

My technical journey has introduced me to Python, C, C++, SQL, databases, web development, data analysis, machine learning and deep learning. I have explored these technologies through academic projects and hands-on internship work.

I am particularly interested in opportunities where I can learn from experienced professionals, contribute to real-world projects, and continue developing as a software or data professional.
